figurative_meaning_en: Day by day; while there is still daylight
example_sentences_in_bangla: আলোয় আলোয় কাজ শেষ করে নাও।
আলোয় আলোয় বাড়ি ফিরে এসো, অন্ধকার হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Finish the work while it's still daylight.
Come home before it gets dark, night will fall soon.
note: This idiom reflects the practical concerns of pre-electricity eras in Bengali rural life.
